help.stdout:
Usage: sqlite3 [OPTIONS] [FILENAME [SQL]]
FILENAME is the name of an SQLite database.
OPTIONS include:
   -bail                stop after hitting an error
   -batch               force batch I/O
   -csv                 set output mode to 'csv'
   -column              set output mode to 'column'
   -box                 set output mode to 'box'
   -html                set output mode to 'html'
   -ascii               set output mode to 'ascii'
   -append              append output to files where supported
   -echo                print inputs before execution
   -escape T            ctrl-char escape; T is one of: symbol, ascii, off
   -ifexists            refuse to create a missing database
   -[no]header          turn headers on or off
   -heap N MIN          set heap configuration
   -help                show this message
   -json                set output mode to 'json'
   -interactive         enable interactive shell mode
   -lookaside N M       set lookaside configuration
   -line                set output mode to 'line'
   -list                set output mode to 'list'
   -mmap N              set mmap size
   -newline SEP         set output row separator. Default: '\n'
   -nullvalue TEXT      set text used for NULL values
   -nofollow            do not follow symlinks when opening
   -pagecache N M       set page cache configuration
   -readonly            open the database read-only
   -rql                 read Redline Query Language JSON from stdin
   -stats               show shell stats
   -separator SEP       set output column separator. Default: '|'
   -unsafe-testing      enable unsafe testing helpers
   -utf8                request UTF-8 mode
   -no-utf8             disable UTF-8 mode
   -vfs NAME            select a virtual file system
   -zip                  open a ZIP archive
   .crlf ON|OFF         toggle CRLF row separators
   .dbinfo              show basic database information
   .dbtotxt             render database contents as text
   .recover             recover database contents as SQL
   -version             show RedlineDB and SQLite compatibility version
